mergeHint: Adds and updates the file's courses and controls; everything else stays. A control keeps its status, extra codes and name; a forked course is left as it is.
noCoursesMergeHint: The file has no courses: only the positions of the controls in it are updated, and new controls are added.

blocker.no_courses: The file holds no courses. Is it the map file rather than the course file?
blocker.duplicate_control: The file lists control {{ids}} more than once.

blocker.duplicate_crossing: The file lists crossing point {{ids}} more than once.
blocker.duplicate_course: The file lists course {{ids}} more than once.
blocker.class_mapped_twice: Class {{className}} is selected for several courses ({{courses}}). Pick one.

classWarning.class_on_several_courses: Class {{className}} is on several courses in the file ({{courses}}). Pick one below.

consequence.runnersOnRemovedCourse_one: {{count}} runner is on a removed course

consequence.controlsMovedFar_one: {{count}} control moves more than 50 m: check it is the same control
consequence.controlsMovedFar_other: {{count}} controls move more than 50 m: check they are the same controls
consequence.coursesSkippedForked_one: {{count}} forked course is left as it is
consequence.coursesSkippedForked_other: {{count}} forked courses are left as they are
consequence.controlsKeepingSettings_one: {{count}} control keeps its status or extra codes
consequence.controlsKeepingSettings_other: {{count}} controls keep their status or extra codes
consequence.coursesKeepingLength_one: {{count}} course keeps its length (the file has none)

consequence.coursesLengthDerived_other: {{count}} new courses get their length from the controls

replaceAllHint: Removes every course and control the file does not have. Classes on a removed course lose it. Controls in the file keep their status and extra codes.
classesFromCourseNamesHint: This file contains no class assignments, so classes were suggested by matching course names. Review the mapping below before importing.
positionsTransformedHint: Control positions were re-projected from the club map "{{sourceMap}}" onto the event's map "{{eventMap}}".
positionsMismatchWarning: The control positions in this file belong to the map "{{sourceMap}}", not the event's map "{{eventMap}}". Imported as they are, the controls will land off the map.
positionsMismatchRemedy: To place them correctly, upload "{{sourceMap}}" as the event's map, or add it to the club map library and import again.
positionsSkippedNote: Control positions were not imported — place the controls in the course editor.

editor.title: Course Editor
editor.hint: Click the map or a control for actions, drag a control to move it, drag a number to reposition it. H hides/shows other controls.
editor.toggleCutsTitle: Automatic circle slits and leg gaps over map features
editor.placementLoupeTitle: Placement loupe: magnify the point a placing tool will drop (L)
editor.noCourseSelected: Select a course to edit its control sequence, or create a new one.
editor.freeOrderHint: Controls may be taken in any order. No leg lines or sequence numbers on the map.

seriesExhausted: Club series exhausted — assigning the next free code ≥ 31.

exportOfflineNotOnline: Storing the maps needs the network.
exportPrintedStored: Printed offline from the maps stored on {{time}}
